name: The "General Pogrom" of Human Rights Defenders and Punitive Psychiatry (1972–1985) (C0089)

techniques.comment: Mass arrests of members of the Ukrainian Helsinki Group and the fabrication of criminal cases: Vasyl Stus was "arrested on January 12, 1972 together with other Ukrainian writer-human rights defenders: I. Svitlychny, Ye. Sverstiuk, Ihor and Iryna Kalynets," and after joining the Helsinki Group in October 1979 he was "arrested a second time on May 14, 1980" and sentenced to 10 years of imprisonment and 5 years of exile(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 9 2012). He "died in the punishment cell of special-regime camp VS-389/36" and was buried "in a nameless grave under No. 9 in the camp cemetery"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 9 2012).

Use of state healthcare institutions for the politically motivated diagnosing of dissenters (the diagnosis of "sluggish schizophrenia") and their indefinite confinement in psychiatric hospitals(Citation: Карательная психиатрия в России: назад в СССР? 2020).
